system.name: CrewAI Conversational RAG
system.description: An enterprise multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and host diagnostics platform built on CrewAI. Combines structured documentation search, multi-tiered memory (MySQL & Blackboard), Windows host telemetry (AggregatorHost.exe), and high-performance asynchronous DNS/network interrogation via c-ares utilities (adig.exe and ahost.exe).
system.architecture: Sequential multi-agent pipeline with Model Context Protocol (FastMCP) integration: Retriever → Aggregator Host Coordinator → Conversational Synthesizer

llm_providers.notes: Primary recommended LLM provider with native tool calling and high reasoning speed.
Secondary fallback provider for OpenAI-compatible inference.

agents.name: Knowledge Retrieval Specialist
agents.description: Searches and retrieves accurate facts, documentation sections, and policy excerpts. Performs preemptive hostname resolution via ahost.exe to verify external endpoints before fetching.

agents.name: Aggregator Host Specialist
agents.description: Central coordinator that aggregates, cross-examines, and synthesizes retrieved findings. Resolves conflicts, manages MySQL shared memory and FileZilla FTP storage, monitors Windows AggregatorHost.exe process health, and conducts low-level DNS diagnostics via adig.exe and ahost.exe.

agents.name: Conversational Synthesizer
agents.description: Synthesizes multi-source facts and diagnostic telemetry into clear, polite, and well-cited conversational answers for end users, dispatching email alerts when requested.

tools.name: Knowledge Base Search
tools.description: Keyword and relevance-based search across all knowledge base documents (.md, .txt, .json, .rst, .csv).
tools.output: Ranked excerpts with source document names and section indices

tools.name: List Knowledge Documents
tools.description: Lists all indexed documents and diagnostic files in the knowledge directory with file sizes.
tools.output: Catalog of document names, file formats, and byte counts

tools.name: Read Complete Document
tools.description: Reads the entire content of a specific knowledge base document by name.
tools.output: Full document markdown or text content

tools.name: Aggregator Host Status Inspector
tools.description: Inspects local host system telemetry, CPU architecture, OS release, and Windows AggregatorHost.exe process health.
tools.output: Host diagnostics report with platform details and tasklist process status

tools.name: JSON Knowledge Search
tools.description: Searches exclusively through structured JSON knowledge files, returning parsed key-value data relevant to the query.
tools.output: Matching JSON fields, hierarchical key paths, and values

tools.name: ADig DNS Query Tool
tools.description: Asynchronous DNS interrogation and query diagnostic tool built on the c-ares resolver engine. Interrogates name servers for specified record types (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CNAME, PTR, SRV), parses response sections, reports TTL and latency, and executes reverse lookups.

input.domain: Target domain name, host, or IP string (e.g., 'google.com', '127.0.0.1')
input.record_type: DNS record type string (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, SOA, CNAME, PTR, ANY)
input.server: Optional custom DNS server IP address (e.g., '8.8.8.8', '1.1.1.1')

tools.output: Structured DNS report with question, answer, authority, and additional record sections

tools.name: AHost Lookup Tool
tools.description: High-speed asynchronous hostname and IP address resolver built on c-ares. Performs dual-stack IPv4 (A) and IPv6 (AAAA) resolution, validates host reachability, queries specific DNS servers with round-robin fallback, and provides resolver debugging output.

input.host: Target hostname or IP address string (e.g., 'google.com', 'localhost')
input.lookup_type: Resolution type ('u' for dual-stack IPv4/IPv6, 'a' for IPv4 only, 'aaaa' for IPv6 only)
input.server: Optional target DNS server IP address
input.debug: Boolean flag for real-time resolver trace debugging

tools.output: List of resolved IPv4 and IPv6 addresses with resolution status

tools.name: MySQL Query Tool
tools.description: Executes read-only SQL queries (SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE) against the XAMPP MySQL database 'crewai_memory'.

tools.name: MySQL Shared Blackboard Tool
tools.description: Reads, writes, and lists shared agent facts and intermediate discoveries in the XAMPP MySQL shared_blackboard table.
tools.output: Confirmation message or stored blackboard value

tools.name: XAMPP FileZilla FTP Storage Tool
tools.description: Uploads, lists, and downloads shared files, logs, and datasets in the XAMPP FileZilla FTP server agent_storage repository.
tools.output: Directory listing or file content payload

tools.name: XAMPP Mercury Mail Tool
tools.description: Dispatches SMTP alert notifications and inspects POP3 incoming mail via the XAMPP Mercury Mail Server.
tools.output: Dispatch confirmation or mailbox message count

command_options.@server: Direct query to specific nameserver IP or URI
command_options.-x addr: Reverse lookup (auto-constructs in-addr.arpa or ip6.arpa PTR query)
command_options.+tcp: Force TCP transport instead of default UDP
command_options.+dns0x20: Enable DNS 0x20 random case bit encoding for cache poisoning defense
command_options.+adflag: Set Authentic Data (AD) bit for DNSSEC validation
command_options.+[no]stats: Toggle query performance statistics and RTT display

use_cases: Validating domain MX mail routing before dispatching SMTP notifications
Verifying SPF, DKIM, and DMARC TXT records for email deliverability
Auditing authoritative nameservers (NS) and SOA zone serials
Testing DNS resolution latency and nameserver failover resilience
Performing reverse DNS lookups on client IP addresses

command_options.-t u: Default mode: resolves and displays both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses
command_options.-s server: Connect to specified DNS server with round-robin fallback

use_cases: Rapid dual-stack connectivity and reachability testing for internal and external endpoints
Validating internal localhost and LAN hostnames (e.g., MySQL, FTP, Mercury servers)
Resolving upstream API domains before establishing HTTP or WebSocket connections
Testing round-robin DNS nameserver responsiveness under load

fastmcp_tools.name: read_mcp_document

fastmcp_tools.name: fetch_url_content

steps.task: Extract relevant evidence from knowledge base documents and verify host reachability via ahost.exe if querying network endpoints.
Aggregate, cross-reference, and validate retrieved facts; inspect Windows AggregatorHost.exe and execute adig.exe/ahost.exe network diagnostics if queried.
Synthesize final conversational response with source citations and dispatch email alerts if requested.
